expected_issues.title: from_db() always called with fetch_mode, breaking documented overrides
expected_issues.description:
Model.from_db() is now always called with a new fetch_mode keyword, which raises TypeError for models overriding from_db() with the documented signature from_db(cls, db, field_names, values).

from_db() is a documented, overridable classmethod. ModelIterable, RawModelIterable and RelatedPopulator now pass `fetch_mode=` unconditionally, so any project overriding from_db() with the previously documented four-argument signature crashes on every query of that model. A backward-compatible path (detect whether the override accepts fetch_mode/**kwargs, call the old signature and emit a deprecation warning) is needed.
